name: Tanagura (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tanagura town emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Tanagura, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1973.

features.role: Tanagura town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a stylised character of horizontal strokes
